definitions.gloss: gathering wild vegetables; foraging for mountain plants
definitions.explanation: The activity of going into mountains or forests to collect edible wild plants such as ferns, bamboo shoots, and wild garlic. A popular seasonal activity in rural Japan, especially in spring.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{山菜採|さんさいと}りに{行|い}く。
examples.english: When spring comes, I go foraging for wild vegetables.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{毎年|まいとし}{山菜採|さんさいと}りを{楽|たの}しみにしている。
examples.english: My grandfather looks forward to wild vegetable foraging every year.

examples.japanese: {山菜採|さんさいと}りに{出|で}かけたが、{熊|くま}の{目撃情報|もくげきじょうほう}があったので{途中|とちゅう}で{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I went out to forage for wild vegetables, but there were reports of bear sightings, so I turned back halfway.

notes:
USAGE:
{山菜採|さんさいと}り is a popular spring activity in rural Japan, especially in the Tohoku and Hokuriku regions. Common {山菜|さんさい} (wild vegetables) include {蕨|わらび} (bracken fern), {蕗|ふき} (butterbur), たらの{芽|め} (aralia sprouts), and {行者|ぎょうじゃ}にんにく (wild garlic).

SAFETY NOTE:
{山菜採|さんさいと}り can be dangerous due to bears, steep terrain, and poisonous look-alike plants. Every year there are news reports of accidents during foraging season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山菜採|さんさいと}りに{行|い}く (to go foraging)
- {山菜採|さんさいと}りに{出|で}かける (to set out for foraging)
- {山菜採|さんさいと}りのシーズン (foraging season)

RELATED WORDS:
- {山菜|さんさい}: wild mountain vegetables
- {潮干狩|しおひが}り: clam digging (another seasonal gathering activity)
- きのこ{狩|が}り: mushroom hunting
